records.title: 10-K
records.text: Fiscal year 2022 net sales of $1.78 billion represented an increase over fiscal year 2021 net sales of $1.37 billion.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal year 2022, the Company delivered record revenue and EPS, driven by high-performance mixed-signal dollar content gains in smartphones.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Changes in excess and obsolete inventory charges, including scrapped inventory, and sales of product written down in prior periods did not have a material impact on margin in fiscal year 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Overall, gross margin for fiscal year 2022 was 51.8 percent.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal years 2022, 2021, and 2020 the Company reported $1.7 million, $2.8 million, and $(1.6) million respectively, in other income (expense), related to remeasurement on foreign currency denominated monetary assets and liabilities and other non-operating income and expenses.
